Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Variable conditions · High 19°C / Low 17°C · Rain: 47 mm · Wind: up to 24 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
